component.name: aws-security-hub
component.title: AWS Security Hub
component.description: Import, query and update security findings in AWS Security Hub.
component.label: cloud,security

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsSecurityHubOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a GetFindingsRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

region.description: The AWS region of Security Hub, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

securityHubClient.label: advanced
securityHubClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.securityhub.SecurityHubClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Security Hub connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Security Hub connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Security Hub uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

profileCredentialsName.label: security
profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Security Hub trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.label: security
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.label: security
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsSecurityHubOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsSecurityHubFindings.description: The findings that batchImportFindings imports, as a List of AwsSecurityFinding. When not set or empty, the findings are taken from the body: a Collection or an array of AwsSecurityFinding, or one AwsSecurityFinding. Security Hub accepts at most 100 findings in one request.

CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingIdentifiers.description: The findings that batchUpdateFindings updates, as a List of AwsSecurityFindingIdentifier, each with the ID of a finding and the ARN of the product that generated it. batchUpdateFindings requires it, and Security Hub accepts at most 100 findings in one request.

CamelAwsSecurityHubFilters.description: The filters that select the findings that getFindings returns. It must be an AwsSecurityFindingFilters object; a value of another type, such as JSON text, fails the exchange.

CamelAwsSecurityHubNote.description: The note that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings, as a NoteUpdate with the text of the note and the name of who updated it. It must be a NoteUpdate object; a value of another type fails the exchange.

CamelAwsSecurityHubSeverity.description: The severity that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings, as a SeverityUpdate, for example with the label HIGH. It must be a SeverityUpdate object; a value of another type fails the exchange.

CamelAwsSecurityHubWorkflow.description: The workflow status that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings, as a WorkflowUpdate with the status NEW, NOTIFIED, RESOLVED or SUPPRESSED. It must be a WorkflowUpdate object; a value of another type fails the exchange.

CamelAwsSecurityHubVerificationState.description: The verification state that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings: UNKNOWN, TRUE_POSITIVE, FALSE_POSITIVE or BENIGN_POSITIVE.

CamelAwsSecurityHubConfidence.description: The confidence that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings: the likelihood, from 0 to 100, that a finding identifies the behavior or issue that it is meant to identify.

CamelAwsSecurityHubCriticality.description: The criticality that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings: the importance, from 0 to 100, of the resources of a finding.

CamelAwsSecurityHubUserDefinedFields.description: The custom name and value pairs that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings, as a Map of String to String.

CamelAwsSecurityHubRelatedFindings.description: The findings that batchUpdateFindings relates to the updated findings, as a List of RelatedFinding, each with the ID of a finding and the ARN of the product that generated it.

CamelAwsSecurityHubTypes.description: The finding types that batchUpdateFindings sets on the findings, each in the format namespace/category/classifier.

CamelAwsSecurityHubNextToken.label: getFindings listEnabledProductsForImport getFindingHistory
CamelAwsSecurityHubNextToken.description: The token for the next set of results. It is both an input and an output: the operation sends it and then sets it to the token of the response, so remove it before calling a different list operation in the same route.

CamelAwsSecurityHubMaxResults.label: getFindings
CamelAwsSecurityHubMaxResults.description: The maximum number of results in one page of getFindings, getFindingHistory or listEnabledProductsForImport. Security Hub accepts a value of at most 100.

CamelAwsSecurityHubFailedCount.label: batchImportFindings
CamelAwsSecurityHubFailedCount.description: The count of findings that failed to import. When it is more than zero, the exchange fails with an exception naming the failed findings.

CamelAwsSecurityHubSuccessCount.label: batchImportFindings
CamelAwsSecurityHubSuccessCount.description: The count of findings that were successfully imported

CamelAwsSecurityHubUnprocessedFindings.label: batchUpdateFindings
CamelAwsSecurityHubUnprocessedFindings.description: The findings that batchUpdateFindings did not update, each with an error code and an error message. Unlike a finding that batchImportFindings does not import, they do not fail the exchange.

CamelAwsSecurityHubProcessedFindings.label: batchUpdateFindings
CamelAwsSecurityHubProcessedFindings.description: The list of findings that were updated successfully

CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingId.label: getFindingHistory
CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingId.description: The ID of the finding whose history getFindingHistory returns. getFindingHistory requires it, together with the CamelAwsSecurityHubProductArn header.

CamelAwsSecurityHubProductArn.label: getFindingHistory
CamelAwsSecurityHubProductArn.description: The ARN of the product that generated the finding whose history getFindingHistory returns. getFindingHistory requires it, together with the CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingId header.

CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingAggregatorArn.label: getFindingAggregator
CamelAwsSecurityHubFindingAggregatorArn.description: The ARN of the finding aggregator whose configuration getFindingAggregator returns. getFindingAggregator requires it.

producerIn.description: batchImportFindings, the default, imports the findings of the CamelAwsSecurityHubFindings header, or else of the body: a Collection or an array of the AwsSecurityFinding of the AWS SDK, or one AwsSecurityFinding. JSON text, a Map, or a Collection or an array of anything else fails. The other operations take their input from headers, such as CamelAwsSecurityHubFilters. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a GetFindingsRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the BatchImportFindingsResponse of batchImportFindings, with the counts in the CamelAwsSecurityHubSuccessCount and CamelAwsSecurityHubFailedCount headers: a finding that is not imported fails the exchange. getFindings gives a GetFindingsResponse, with the token of the next page in the CamelAwsSecurityHubNextToken header
